tile.gtsr.critical_v2.alloy_frame.toolti.zh_CN: 支撑基座边梁、织机轨架与恒星约束结构。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.alloy_frame.toolti.en_US: Supports foundation beams, loom gantries and stellar confinement structures.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.alloy_frame.toolti.zh_CN: 保持承重连接完整；合金框架在作业中固定不动。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.alloy_frame.toolti.en_US: Keep load-bearing connections intact; the frame remains fixed during operation.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.reinforced_panel.t.zh_CN: 为大型机器提供加固蒙皮与检修外板。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.reinforced_panel.t.en_US: Provides reinforced cladding and service panels for large machines.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.reinforced_panel.t.zh_CN: 按结构定义组成外壳；拉丝钛板保持静态。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.reinforced_panel.t.en_US: Forms the casing defined by the structure; brushed titanium panels remain static.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_armor.tool.zh_CN: 划分恒星腔隔热层与基座绝缘环。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_armor.tool.en_US: Defines stellar chamber thermal shielding and foundation insulation rings.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_armor.tool.zh_CN: 白陶瓷分区必须连续；以完整结构检查为准。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_armor.tool.en_US: Keep white ceramic sections continuous; validity follows the full structure check.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_dark.toolt.zh_CN: 隔开线圈托座、镜框与相邻承重构件。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_dark.toolt.en_US: Separates coil supports, lens frames and adjacent load-bearing parts.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_dark.toolt.zh_CN: 深灰陶瓷用于固定绝缘接缝，不显示运行读数。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.ceramic_dark.toolt.en_US: Dark ceramic forms fixed insulating joints and carries no operational readout.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.carbon_frame.toolt.zh_CN: 构成人造恒星内腔与大型构件的深色承载筋。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.carbon_frame.toolt.en_US: Forms dark support ribs for the artificial star chamber and large components.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.carbon_frame.toolt.zh_CN: 按承重节点连接受力结构，保持支架连接完整。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.carbon_frame.toolt.en_US: Connect load-bearing structures at their support nodes and keep frame connections intact.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.copper_busbar.tool.zh_CN: 沿供能路径连接端口、线圈与耦合节点。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.copper_busbar.tool.en_US: Links ports, coils and coupling nodes along the power route.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.copper_busbar.tool.zh_CN: 暖铜纹理标识导电路径；母线本体固定、不闪烁。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.copper_busbar.tool.en_US: Warm copper marks conductive paths; the busbar body remains fixed without flashing.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.zh_CN: 连接约束线圈段与冷却接口。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.en_US: Couples confinement coil sections to cooling interfaces.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.zh_CN: 接点与托座须完整，灰钢外框保持固定。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.en_US: Keep contacts and supports intact; the steel rim remains fixed.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.zh_CN: 工作时蓝紫电子接点依次点亮，停机回到静态表面。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.superconducting_co.en_US: Blue-violet electronic contacts light in sequence while working and return to a static surface when inactive.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.zh_CN: 构成恒星磁约束环与基座磁悬段。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.en_US: Forms stellar confinement rings and magnetic foundation sections.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.zh_CN: 按结构定义连接线圈、托座与供能路径。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.en_US: Connect coils, supports and power routes as defined by the structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.zh_CN: 局部蓝色接点指示工作节奏，线圈壳体不变色。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.magnetic_coil.tool.en_US: Local blue contacts indicate the work rhythm while the coil casing keeps its colour.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.blue_field_glass.t.zh_CN: 为约束结构与内部机构提供冷蓝观察窗。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.blue_field_glass.t.en_US: Provides cold-blue viewing windows into confinement structures and internal mechanisms.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.blue_field_glass.t.zh_CN: 只用于结构定义的观察窗位；金属窗框保持完整。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.blue_field_glass.t.en_US: Use only at defined windows and keep the metal frame intact.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.violet_phase_glass.zh_CN: 为高阶基座悬相腔提供紫灰观察窗。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.violet_phase_glass.en_US: Provides muted-violet viewing windows into advanced foundation phase chambers.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.violet_phase_glass.zh_CN: 保持窗口与框架完整；玻璃本体不发光。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.violet_phase_glass.en_US: Keep windows and frames intact; the glass itself emits no light.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.luminous_rail.tool.zh_CN: 为织机轨架标示施工定位与导向路径。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.luminous_rail.tool.en_US: Marks construction alignment and guide paths on the loom gantry.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.luminous_rail.tool.zh_CN: 工作时青色定位点沿槽移动，轨架本体保持固定。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.luminous_rail.tool.en_US: Teal alignment markers travel along the channel while the rail body remains fixed.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.fuel_socket.toolti.zh_CN: 标识恒星燃料输送结构的耦合节点。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.fuel_socket.toolti.en_US: Marks coupling nodes in the stellar fuel delivery structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.fuel_socket.toolti.zh_CN: 燃料供给由对应输入舱接入；耦合座沿燃料输送节点连接。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.fuel_socket.toolti.en_US: Supply fuel through the corresponding input hatch and connect the mount along fuel delivery nodes.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.heat_grille.toolti.zh_CN: 构成机壳下部与维护区的金属通风分区。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.heat_grille.toolti.en_US: Forms metal ventilation sections beneath the casing and around service areas.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.heat_grille.toolti.zh_CN: 格栅保持静态；按结构定义留出维护通道。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.heat_grille.toolti.en_US: The grille remains static; preserve the defined service routes.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.hazard_stripe.tool.zh_CN: 以黄黑条纹标识高能腔口与作业接口边界。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.hazard_stripe.tool.en_US: Marks high-energy chamber openings and work interface boundaries with yellow-black stripes.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.hazard_stripe.tool.zh_CN: 警戒标识保持静态，运行状态请查看主结构控制器。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.hazard_stripe.tool.en_US: Warning marks remain static; inspect the main structure controller for operating status.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.rubber.tooltip.1.zh_CN: 分隔端口密封面与活动机构边界。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.rubber.tooltip.1.en_US: Separates port sealing surfaces from moving mechanism boundaries.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.rubber.tooltip.2.zh_CN: 按接口轮廓连接，深色密封纹理不参与工作动画。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.rubber.tooltip.2.en_US: Fit to the interface outline; dark sealing textures remain static.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.zh_CN: 构成拟态织机的物料送料滚筒。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.en_US: Forms the material feed rollers of the mimetic loom.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.zh_CN: 施工材料通过物品总线供给，卷轴负责表现送料机构。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.en_US: Supply construction materials through item buses; the spool represents the feed mechanism.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.zh_CN: 施工时铜色脊纹离散移动，卷轴不发光。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_spool.tooltip.en_US: Copper ridges move in discrete steps during construction; the spool emits no light.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_guide.tooltip.zh_CN: 连接施工头与织机轨架的定位导向结构。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_guide.tooltip.en_US: Connects the construction head to the loom gantry alignment structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_guide.tooltip.zh_CN: 保持导轨完整，青色定位标只在导向槽内移动。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_guide.tooltip.en_US: Keep the guide rail intact; teal alignment markers move only inside the guide channel.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.zh_CN: 显示织机施工状态与驱动节奏。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.en_US: Displays loom construction status and drive rhythm.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.zh_CN: 织机施工由本机控制器操作，结构配置在主结构控制器查询。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.en_US: Operate loom construction at its machine controller and inspect structure configuration at the main structure controller.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.zh_CN: 工作时小屏局部扫描，冷银框与方向标保持固定。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_controller.to.en_US: Local screen pixels scan during work; the cold-silver frame and direction marks remain fixed.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.zh_CN: 为外挂磁悬装甲插件提供贴合与耦合节点。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.en_US: Provides attachment and coupling nodes for external magnetic armour modules.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.zh_CN: 插件沿基座外缘挂载，闭合贴合面不表示空插槽。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.en_US: Modules attach along the foundation rim; the closed coupling pad is not an empty socket.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.zh_CN: 工作时只点亮小型接点，装甲板体保持柔和灰钢色。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.plugin_socket.tool.en_US: Only small contacts light while working; armour panels retain their muted steel finish.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.zh_CN: 显示基座承载区域的局部状态。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.en_US: Displays local status around the foundation load-bearing sections.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.zh_CN: 完整结构与插件配置在主结构控制器查询。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.en_US: Inspect the full structure and module configuration at the main structure controller.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.zh_CN: 暗底蓝紫读数局部变化，基座外壳不随之闪烁。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.foundation_status_.en_US: Blue-violet readouts change locally on a dark screen without flashing the foundation casing.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.zh_CN: 构成人造恒星能量导出结构的分层聚束节点。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.en_US: Forms layered focusing nodes in the artificial star energy routing structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.zh_CN: 钢环、金色夹座与观察镜面必须完整。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.en_US: Keep steel rings, gold-toned mounts and optical surfaces intact.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.zh_CN: 聚束金环保持暖辉与稳定照明，同类镜阵六面连接，镜面细部保留。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_lens.toolt.en_US: The focusing gold ring provides warm radiance and steady illumination; matching lens arrays join on all six faces while retaining optical detail.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.zh_CN: 构成磁约束腔内部的恒星核心表面。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.en_US: Forms the stellar core surface inside the magnetic confinement chamber.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.zh_CN: 限定于核心内腔，外围由约束环与隔热结构包围。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.en_US: Confined to the inner core and surrounded by confinement rings and thermal shielding.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.zh_CN: 核心保持稳定暖辉并照亮约束腔，热纹随作业演化；同类核心六面连续。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.stellar_plasma_ski.en_US: The core maintains steady warm radiance and illuminates the confinement chamber; thermal patterns evolve during work and matching core blocks join on all six faces.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.coolant_channel.to.zh_CN: 连接约束环与外挂插件的冷却路径。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.coolant_channel.to.en_US: Links cooling routes around confinement rings and external modules.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.coolant_channel.to.zh_CN: 工作时冷蓝流标在狭窄管槽内移动，导管保持固定。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.coolant_channel.to.en_US: Cold-blue flow markers move inside the narrow channel while its body remains fixed.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.zh_CN: 管理绑定的基座与上层机器结构。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.en_US: Manages the bound foundation and upper machine structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.zh_CN: 右键查看整机类型、结构配置与运行状态。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.en_US: Right-click to inspect machine type, structure configuration and operating status.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.zh_CN: 深蓝紫总控徽记面朝南，与织机本机控制器同高对望。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_controller.tool.en_US: The deep blue-violet command emblem faces south, opposite the loom machine controller at the same height.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_hatch.tooltip.1.zh_CN: 为绑定结构提供流体或能源供给接口。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_hatch.tooltip.1.en_US: Provides a fluid or power supply interface for the bound structure.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_hatch.tooltip.2.zh_CN: 按对应 GT 舱类型接入供给，并保持舱口位置有效。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_hatch.tooltip.2.en_US: Connect supplies for the corresponding GT hatch type and keep the hatch at a valid position.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_bus.tooltip.1.zh_CN: 为织机施工与机器作业提供物品接口。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_bus.tooltip.1.en_US: Provides item interfaces for loom construction and machine operation.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_bus.tooltip.2.zh_CN: 通过对应 GT 总线管理物料；织机供需状态在本机控制器查询。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gt_bus.tooltip.2.en_US: Manage materials through the corresponding GT bus and inspect loom supply requirements at its machine controller.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.maintenance_grate..zh_CN: 构成基座内的金属检修走道与维护分区。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.maintenance_grate..en_US: Forms metal service walkways and maintenance sections inside the foundation.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.maintenance_grate..zh_CN: 保持检修通道畅通；走道格栅固定、不发光。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.maintenance_grate..en_US: Keep service routes clear; walkway grating remains fixed and unlit.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..zh_CN: 构成承载与悬浮组件的下向引力场调制节点。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..en_US: Forms downward-acting gravity field modulation nodes for load-bearing and suspension components.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..zh_CN: 下向扇形窗以淡蓝紫局部发光标示作用方向。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..en_US: A pale blue-violet fan window marks the downward action with local light.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..zh_CN: 向下释放调制场流，维持悬浮组件的支撑；模块与所属组件同步。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.gravity_modulator..en_US: Releases modulated field flow downward to support suspended components; the module moves with its parent component.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.zh_CN: 构成人造恒星内腔的热场耦合环。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.en_US: Forms thermal field coupling rings inside the artificial star chamber.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.zh_CN: 暖色热场线圈与外层冷色电磁供能接点分区。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.en_US: Warm thermal coils are separated from the outer cool-coloured electromagnetic power contacts.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.zh_CN: 工作时细部维持稳定暖辉，模块与所属组件同步。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.thermal_confinemen.en_US: Fine details maintain a steady warm radiance during work; the module moves with its parent component.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.zh_CN: 显示并管理拟态织机本机的供料与施工状态。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.en_US: Displays and manages the mimetic loom's material supply and construction state.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.zh_CN: 右键本机控制器操作施工；整机类型与基座设置由主结构控制器管理。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.en_US: Right-click this controller to operate construction; machine type and foundation settings are managed by the main structure controller.

tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.zh_CN: 冷蓝织线徽记面朝北，与主结构控制器同高对望。
tile.gtsr.critical_v2.loom_machine_contr.en_US: The cold-blue woven emblem faces north, opposite the main structure controller at the same height.
